remarks: Highest/Best noon Wednesday, Oct.9. Charming, one-of-a-kind, colonial updated & maintained with attention to every detail. Main floor has 9' ceilings, crown molding, original refinished hardwood floors, cozy LR with fireplace, seating area, sunroom with wall of windows for abundant natural light. Enter new Chef's kitchen w/ manufactured stone counters & island, farm sink, 48" fridge, drawer microwave, wine chiller, 6 burner gas range, eating area w/ French doors leading to expansive deck overlooking gated, private backyard. Additionally, remodeled full bath with stall shower & radiant floors, laundry room added w/ new W/D, & mudroom. Upstairs has crown molding, 4 pristine bedrooms w/ custom closets, and fully, remodeled bath with tub/shower. There is an additional W/D in the basement. Enjoy this delightful home with its proximity to restaurants, parks, beach, SoNo, Mall, libraries, and train station. A 'few' updates: New Roof and Cedar shingles, Marvin windows, Underground wiring from the street, Full irrigation system w/ automated smart sprinklers, Updated electrical to 200 Amp, Zoned Central AC & heat, Nest thermostats, Google cameras inside/out, Exterior & interior house painted, Complete chimney lining & capping, 120v & 240v Exterior outlets added to the driveway for EV charging, New vinyl latice under deck, Yard aerated, seeded & fertilized for Fall. FYI: All walls painted & patched therefore no paintings have been hung to preserve the surface for new owners.
